network_status.summary_it: Il rapporto ARPAL ricostruisce l'evento ligure del 9-13 novembre e le sezioni idrometriche disponibili, ma non pubblica una misura sul Rio Ciliegio a Trasta. I livelli osservati su altri corsi d'acqua non vengono trasferiti al ponte.
network_status.summary_en: The ARPAL report reconstructs the 9-13 November Ligurian event and the available hydrometric sections, but publishes no measurement for the Rio Ciliegio at Trasta. Levels observed on other watercourses are not transferred to the bridge.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
